candidates.reason: A real banner rearrangement with a strong 3-line headline and the product in its circle up top, but the fine print 'Now in 4-packs and singles' wraps into a cramped 4-line sliver beside the CTA. The body copy sits close to 'bottled.' with no clear gutter, the CTA is small next to the huge headline, and the top-left circle is clumsily cropped.

This is a shrunk copy of the square layout, not a resize. The body copy, the fine print and the 'SOLSTICE' label are too small to read at 300x250, the CTA label is tiny, the bottle is small and there is dead space in the lower right. It fails the 'rearrange, don't shrink' brief.

The right-column headline, copy and a strong CTA read well, but the bottle loses its circle backdrop and floats small and isolated on the left. The fine print sits above the CTA, which breaks reading order, the text column is jammed toward the right edge, and the lower left is empty.

Effectively identical to candidate 1, with the same flaws: fine print squeezed into a narrow 4-line wrap beside an undersized CTA, body copy crowding the headline, and an awkwardly cropped decorative circle at top left.
